A CLEAR SCOPE

What your service quote covers

The proposal identifies the task, replacement products or parts, access equipment, site arrangements and timing.

Start with these details

  • City or site address and preferred dates.
  • Number of poles, approximate height and what needs doing.
  • Ground-level photos and any existing product records.
REQUEST THIS SERVICE

START WITH THE RIGHT DETAILS

A seasonal change can align flags with a property schedule, event or planned replacement cycle. A clear brief identifies what comes down, what goes up and how the old flags should be handled.

01

Flag schedule

List the approved designs, dimensions, quantities and intended change dates for each display.

02

Site access

Identify the property contact and any work windows, locks or access procedures that affect the visit.

03

Replacement details

State whether flags are supplied by you or requested with the service. Agree handling of removed flags rather than assuming disposal or storage.

MAKE YOUR REQUEST USEFUL

A better brief.
A clearer quote.

Send the current display details, replacement artwork or flag list and preferred dates.

REQUEST SERVICE

GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Can the same schedule cover several properties?

A multi-location request can list each site’s dates, contacts and flag requirements. Service arrangements are assessed separately for the locations involved.

What if I do not know the model or dimensions?

Send the information you have, including existing records and photos taken from a safe position. Do not climb, dismantle or alter the display to complete the enquiry.
